key_decisions.rationale: Keeps household scope, devotion, generosity, beneficiaries, and prayer.
key_decisions.before: He was devout and feared God along with his whole household. He gave generously to the poor among the people and prayed continually to God.
key_decisions.after: He and his whole household were devout and feared God. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God continually.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He was a devout man who feared God with all his household; he gave alms generously to the people and prayed continually to God.

key_decisions.rationale: Names participants for clarity and preserves fear, question, prayer, alms, ascent, and memorial image.
key_decisions.before: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel said, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have gone up as a memorial before God.
key_decisions.after: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel replied, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have risen before God as a memorial.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Cornelius stared at him in terror and said, “What is it, Lord?” And the angel said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial before God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps opened heaven, cautious simile, sheet image, descent, and four corners.
key_decisions.before: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being lowered to the earth by its four corners.
key_decisions.after: and saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being lowered to earth by its four corners.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He saw heaven opened and something like a great sheet coming down, being let down by its four corners upon the earth.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the three creature groups and inclusive scope.
key_decisions.before: In it were all kinds of four-footed animals, reptiles of the earth, and birds of the sky.
key_decisions.after: In it were all kinds of four-footed animals, reptiles of the earth, and birds of the sky.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: In it were all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles and birds of the air.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves emphatic refusal and paired purity terms.
key_decisions.before: But Peter said, “Certainly not, Lord! I have never eaten anything common or unclean.”
key_decisions.after: But Peter replied, “Certainly not, Lord! I have never eaten anything defiled or unclean.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But Peter said, “By no means, Lord; for I have never eaten anything common or unclean.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps repetition, divine action, and prohibition.
key_decisions.before: The voice came to him again a second time: “What God has made clean, you must not call common.”
key_decisions.after: The voice spoke to him a second time: “What God has made clean, you must not call defiled.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the voice came to him again a second time, “What God has made clean, you must not call common.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves three commands, absence of discrimination, and Spirit agency.
key_decisions.before: Get up, go downstairs, and go with them without making distinctions, because I have sent them.”
key_decisions.after: Get up, go downstairs, and go with them without hesitation, because I have sent them.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Rise and go down and go with them without hesitation, for I have sent them.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves credentials, national testimony, angelic instruction, invitation, and hearing.
key_decisions.before: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous and God-fearing man who is well spoken of by the whole Jewish nation, was directed by a holy angel to send for you so that you could come to his house and he could hear what you have to say.”
key_decisions.after: They replied, “Cornelius, a centurion who is righteous and fears God and is well spoken of by the whole Jewish nation, was directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and hear what you have to say.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And they said, “Cornelius, a centurion, an upright and God-fearing man, well spoken of by the whole Judean nation, was directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and to hear what you have to say.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps meeting, posture, and reverential act.
key_decisions.before: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell at his feet, and bowed before him.
key_decisions.after: As Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell at his feet, and bowed down before him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him and fell down at his feet and worshiped him.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves stated social boundary and God’s human-focused correction.
key_decisions.before: He said to them, “You yourselves know how improper it is for a Jewish man to associate closely with or visit someone from another people. But God has shown me that I should call no human being common or unclean.
key_decisions.after: He told them, “You know that it is considered unlawful for a Jewish man to associate with or visit a foreigner. But God has shown me that I must not call any person defiled or unclean.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to them, “You yourselves know how unlawful it is for a Judean to associate with or to visit someone from another people; but God has shown me that I should not call any human being common or unclean.
